description: Structural edit operations over an : finding, adding, moving, removing and duplicating blocks, sections and columns. All operations work across nested hero/group/wrapper containers via .

members.name: AddBlock
members.description: Inserts a block into the column with the given id at (clamped). Returns if no such column exists.

members.name: AddColumn
members.description: Adds a column to the section and rebalances all columns to equal widths.

members.name: DuplicateBlock
members.description: Inserts a deep copy (with fresh ids) of the block immediately after the original, in the same container. Returns the copy, or if the block was not found.

members.name: DuplicateSection
members.description: Inserts a deep copy (with fresh ids) of a top-level section immediately after the original. Returns the copy, or if the section was not found.

members.name: FindBlock
members.description: Finds a block anywhere in the document by id, or returns .

members.name: FindParentColumn
members.description: Returns the column that directly contains the given block, or when the block is held by a non-column container (e.g. a hero) or does not exist.

members.name: MoveBlock
members.description: Moves a block to the target column at (clamped, evaluated after removal). Returns if the block or target column is missing.

members.name: MoveSection
members.description: Moves a top-level section to (clamped after removal).

members.name: RebalanceColumns
members.description: Sets every column in the section to an equal share of the width (summing to 100%).

members.name: RemoveBlock
members.description: Removes a block from wherever it lives in the tree. Returns whether it was found.

members.name: RemoveColumn
members.description: Removes a column by id and rebalances the remaining columns. Returns whether found.

members.name: RemoveSection
members.description: Removes a top-level section by id. Returns whether it was found.
